problem.description: What is wrong or wanted, in your owner's words, with who asked. Required for a new start, unless you send only the old task.

done.description: Outcomes the worker can check itself, one line each. Required with problem. The accept and review tasks check exactly this list.

evidence.description: The facts you already have, one line each.

hypothesis.description: Your guess at the cause or the fix. The brief marks it as the worker's to drop if it is wrong.

scope.description: What not to touch and the known traps.

task.description: Extra notes only: the old free-text task. Optional now. A call with only task still works for older callers. A file a running worker or open change holds is reported in brief_flags; it never refuses the start. The change or worker this start targets (continue, fixes, base) is not an overlap.

continue.description: ID of an ended worker to continue.

auto_continue.description: Whether the daemon may continue unfinished work.

title.description: One short line naming the worker, at most 60 characters, with no newlines. Leave it empty to derive a title from the task.

fixes.description: Change ID (ch_...) of a shipped change this worker fixes. agent-net records a defect on the worker that made that change, so do not file it yourself.

fixes_severity.description: Severity of that defect, 1 to 4. Default 2.

owner_line.description: One line for the caller to tell its user: the model and the judged difficulty.

accepted.description: The start is accepted but the difficulty judge or the launch is still running. A worker notice arrives when the worker starts, waits in the queue or does not start. Do not start it again.

brief_flags.description: Advisory notes on the brief, one per problem: the check, the line it is about and the reason. A start is never refused or held by them.
